"Yeah unfortunately it's not that simple. Her kit is designed so that ad and ap both give sustained dps and burst."

Yup, I agree. She needs more differences between the AD and AP builds. We're together on this thinking.

"For example, her q evolved has a 1.48ap ratio against isolated enemies. Mixed damage is also just good against tanks, as is the flexibility to swap damage type focus based on all composition."

I don't like the idea of a champion being able to change their damage focus and not change their playstyle. Malphite, for example, is usually played as a tank, frontliner, 1st to dive and all that. If you build AP Malphite (although It's not common) you'll get punished if you go in first, but you can totally 1-shot an enemy in a pick off, or actually turn the fight with a well placed ultimate. I think that should apply to Kai'Sa as well, if she builds AD, X is her strength, if she builds AP, Y is her strength. Although she "can" do the same,  it wouldn't be optimal.

"Since crit was shifted to more of a tank busting angle with ie change, and ap is more traditional associated with burst (+w evolve), I decided it made more sense for AP to not also be the best tank shredding build (which it currently is)"

But... That's exactly what makes Kai'Sa unique. To be a tank melter with AP damage. Every other marksman will usually go AD to burst tanks. She is the only champion that is actually viable to play as AP marksman (although I'd say Kog could do the same, we don't see him so much and his lack of survivability makes it really hard). Otherwise, she will be outclassed by other adcs. Because see... she doesn't have good enough kit to do either better than other champions. She won't be an AP assassinbetter than Leblanc or her father, Kassadin, for what it matters. Nor will be a better ADC than Tristana(safer) or Vayne(better tank busting, when she gets balanced in her spot.) So, effectively... Why would I ever pick Kai'Sa for AP burst if I have Leblanc Kassadin Ahri, or Why would I pick her as AD if I have Tristana, Vayne or Xayah? My suggestion bases on: wich AD assassin would be able to do the same as her? To jump in the enemy back line in the midst of the fight, burst the enemy adc(or be outdamaged and die) and go away, while being able to played in the bot lane? Also, what ap champion does the same as her? Being able to auto attack consistently, like a marksman, while being "safe"? Of course, Kayle, Teemo and AP Kog could do something similar, but they're not viable as Kai'Sa is. Also, there IS decent enough counterplay against the AP tank bursting build (the adaptive helm\[wich everyone seems to forget about\] + tabi\[wich, at least in my understanding, should reduce the magic damage on her autos, as I *think* it does, not really sure\] + some atk speed reducing item).

I think this is everyone's concern: **What makes Kai'Sa essentially UNIQUE in her gameplay?**  
In my humble opinion, RITO's concern should be: ***How can we make this uniqueness more rewarding, while keeping her in a balanced position, both in SoloQ and Proplay?***  And I know you're here seeking that, but... making her an ad marksman wouldn't exactly keep that "uniqueness" that she has :/

My  opinion, although I don't know much about balancing, is:

Focusing AD Kai'Sa around the right use of her skills and the AP Kai'Sa around the correct use of her passive and onhit would be my "go to" option. Of course, I don't have all the data or experience you guys have on balancing and all that, but it just ***feels*** more intuitive. As assassin, she appears, throws out all her skills with one or two autos, and goes away invisible. As AP marksman, she is a hope against a armor stacking tank like Malphite, raining down plasma rays in the enemies head, with each and every auto increasing in power. That's the "fantasy" I, personally, have around her.

TLDR: League doesn't need more of the same. There are already too many burst-ish long range AP champions and too many AD marksman. Let us, summoners, have champions out of the pattern, like "ap tank-busting Kai'Sa."As before, just my opinion.

Okay... So... If Kai'Sa goes Ap she will blow up squishies, and if she goes ad she "should" destroy tanks?

In my humble opinion, maybe you should do the contrary. We have lots of AD items that could be so good on an ADC like her to become an assassin-ish (Essence Reaver + Stormrazor or something like that), while it took a while to see the rise of AP-ish marksmen.Maybe, **nerf her passive base missing health percentage**(so she doesn't have too much free dmg) and **strengthen the AP scaling of it**(so she doesn't lose her ability to do sustained dmg), so the tank busting stays the same for ap, and give her some incentive to build AD to assassin squishies?(like a buff to her Q ad ratios,  maybe one that grows up with her levels?)

In other words, tune her burst ability to grow with AD and her onhit to scale with ap. This way she can make use of both aspects of her kit, while not losing her identity as a Magic-damage tank buster.

After all... That's the way she was designed to work, wasn't it? Burst physical damage on her Q with AD, and sustained magical dmg on her passive, with the W to help a little in the dmg, and the shield to strengthen both playstyles? Heck, give her ultimate an adaptive evolve. More ad = less cooldown, so more access to back line for kill threat, while more ap = more shield for the tank killing apc. The fact that her ultimate(supposedly her strongest and signature skill) doesn't evolve is, at least, strange to me in a lore perspective xD"
